Question 7

Find the particular solution to the differential equation dydx+e−y=4x3e−y that satisfies y(1)=0.

a
y=ln⁡(x2+12)
b
 y=ln⁡(x4−x)
c
y=ln⁡(x4−x+22)
d
y=ln⁡(x4−x+1)
e
y=ln⁡(x2+2x−2)
